description: Text edge cases, deliberately the highest-numbered case: the corpus runner aborts on the first harness crash, so if any of these does crash the engine, 011 and 012 have already run and can still be frozen. Covers the empty message, a single character, a ~520-char message (the plan calls for 500+), a 78-char unbroken word that forces the mid-word split documented in the bug-for-bug ledger, and Latin-1 high bytes via \u escapes (ojson caps escapes at 0xFF by design - the corpus is byte-oriented and the CJK path is out of scope).
